hotelOccupancy.metric: San Francisco hotel occupancy rate, 4-week moving average (percent), weekly; City Performance Scorecard measure 7188 "Hotel Occupancy Rate - 4 Week Moving Average" (department "Multiple Departments"; the Controller's Status of the SF Economy cites STR for the same weekly 4-week MA series)

notes: The scorecard categories category_2 / category_3 are undocumented percent changes (likely vs. prior year and vs. 2019 or prior period); not used.

A 4-week moving average ending on the last Saturday of a month approximates that calendar month; "last4wkMAInMonth" is that value. "meanOf4wkMA" averages all in-month weekly MA values and so lags by ~1.5 weeks.

caltrain.metric: Caltrain systemwide average weekday ridership (AWR, unlinked boardings, Mon-Fri excluding holidays)

2022-10.method: Clipper taps + limited conductor counts (Apr 2020-Oct 2023 method)

2024-07.method: Fare Media Sales-Based model (monthly pass = 26 trips/month assumption, pre-Jan 2025)

2025-07.method: Fare Media model (37 trips/pass from Jan 2025)

notes: Three different estimation regimes: pre-Nov 2023 (Clipper + conductor counts), Nov 2023-Dec 2024 fare-media model with 26 trips per monthly pass, Jan 2025 on with 37 trips per monthly pass. The Jan 2025 revision raises estimates for pass-heavy markets, so part of the 2024->2026 AWR growth (23,291/24,762 -> 47,459) is methodological; Caltrain gives no back-cast of 2024 under the new assumption.

Electrified service began 2024-09-21 (20% more weekday service, faster trips, weekend trains 32 -> 66), so Jul/Aug 2024 is the diesel timetable and Jul/Aug 2026 the electric one: the Caltrain change is partly a supply change, not only a demand driver.
August 2026 AWR was not yet published (it will be in the October 2026 JPB Executive Director report).

serviceChanges.description: New Muni service period (GTFS calendar 2022-10-01 to 2023-01-06 replaces 2022-07-30 to 2022-09-30). No SFMTA notice found describing route changes for this date; treat as a schedule refresh.

Central Subway opened with a special weekend-only shuttle between 4th & Brannan and Chinatown-Rose Pak (stopping Yerba Buena/Moscone, Union Square/Market St), Sat-Sun Nov 19-20 and following weekends through 2022, 8 a.m.-12 a.m., free in Nov-Dec 2022. KT Ingleside-Third unchanged on weekdays.

Full Central Subway service: T Third runs Chinatown-Rose Pak to Sunnydale via 4th & Brannan, Yerba Buena/Moscone, Union Square/Market St; T no longer runs on King St, The Embarcadero or the Market St subway. KT Ingleside-Third interline ended; K Ingleside runs Balboa Park-Embarcadero. T Third span weekdays 6 a.m.-12 a.m., weekends 8 a.m.-12 a.m.; early-morning/late-night T Third Bus rerouted via 3rd/4th Streets to Chinatown.

Same-day changes: 6 Haight/Parnassus runs until 12 a.m. daily (was 10 p.m.); 21 Hayes extended to Fulton St & 8th Ave weekdays after 7 p.m. and all day weekends; service added on 28 19th Avenue and 38R Geary Rapid (crowding); 12 Folsom/Pacific and 36 Teresita terminal changes/minor reroutes near Cesar Chavez & Valencia; 4th & Folsom / 4th & Howard stops consolidated. No changes to 8 Bayshore, 30 Stockton, 45 Union/Stockton or 15 Bayview Hunters Point Express were listed in the notice.
New weekday-only 1X California Express: inbound mornings, outbound late afternoon/evening, 33rd Ave-Arguello express segment to relieve the 1 California east of Arguello.

1 California every 5 min (was 6) on Clay & Drumm-Presidio & California segment from Aug 19, every 10 min weekdays west of Presidio; 9 San Bruno uses 60-ft buses on weekends; extra morning school trips on 28R and 48 (from Aug 19); 15 Bayview Hunters Point Express outbound terminal loop via Newhall/Palou; 67 Bernal Heights outbound via 26th St.
L Taraval trains resume Embarcadero-SF Zoo after the L Taraval Improvement Project; L Bus discontinued (10-min weekday, 12-min weekend train frequency).

K Ingleside and M Ocean View one-car trains on weekends; 30X Marina Express restored (two inbound AM trips 7:15 and 7:45 from Beach & Divisadero); 1X loses its 7:15 and 7:45 AM trips; midday (10 a.m.-1 p.m.) weekday headways widened: 24 Divisadero 10->12 min, 38 Geary 8->10, 43 Masonic 12->15; stop changes on many routes. (An SFMTA page with URL slug ...effective-saturday-september-28-2024 now carries this Feb 1, 2025 notice and also describes L Taraval rail Zoo-Embarcadero with a new Ulloa & 14th Ave stop.)
30S Stockton short-turn narrowed to Van Ness & North Point - Union Square.

Budget cuts (~2% of service, ~$7M, FY2026 deficit): 5 Fulton (weekday 7a-7p) and 9 San Bruno (weekday 7a-7p) turn back at McAllister/Civic Center and 11th & Market/Van Ness; 31 Balboa runs Cabrillo & La Playa - 5th & Market/Powell all day; 6 Haight/Parnassus and 21 Hayes consolidated into new 6 Hayes/Parnassus (Inner Sunset-Civic Center, 6 alignment west of Masonic, 21 alignment east of Masonic, 5 a.m.-12 a.m., 20-min); 7 Haight/Noriega span 5 a.m.-midnight; 48 Hoffman St by-request segment dropped. 5R and 9R unchanged.

1X 7:15 and 7:45 AM trips restored (from Sep 2); 30X adds an 8:15 AM trip and terminal/stop changes (from Sep 2); 49 Van Ness/Mission extra inbound peak frequency 7:30-8:15 a.m.; 8 and 29 schedule adjustments; 6 Hayes/Parnassus new stop at Masonic & Oak; 56 stop relocation.

Potrero Yard closed for rebuild; bus mix changes: 5 Fulton weekends every 7 min (was 10), 5R every 8 min (was 10) at busy times; 14 Mission weekends every 8 min (was 7); 15 adds Stockton & Geary stop toward Bayview; 48 outbound via Ulloa instead of Vicente/West Portal; stop relocations (1, 35, 37, K Bus, L Owl, 58) and schedule tweaks (1X, 27, 54, 57, 90, 91).

5R schedule tightened; 14 Mission/14 Owl late-night trips added ~10:15 p.m.-1:15 a.m.; some 31 inbound trips end with drop-off at Geary & Masonic; 35 Eureka terminal back to Market & Castro; stop removals on 48 (23rd & Vermont) and 28/30/91 (North Point & Larkin).

30-foot bus fleet withdrawn for safety inspections after a June 2026 vehicle issue; 40-foot substitutions: 37 Corbett inbound rerouted via Roosevelt Way (four Buena Vista/Upper Terrace stops missed) until 2026-09-28; 36 Teresita substituted, regular routing resumed 2026-07-06.

After the Jul-Aug 2026 window except Aug 29-31: 1 California every 9 min (was 10); N Judah peak every 9 min (was 10); all 5R trips on 60-ft buses every 10 min; 8AX one-seat ride Visitacion Valley-Francisco Middle School.

notes: BART exits: average weekday exits (all entry stations) by exit station from BART monthly OD workbooks. The Oct/Nov 2022 and Feb/Mar 2023 workbooks use sheet "Avg Weekday OD" with header "Exit stations" (rows) / "Entry stations->" (columns); 2024/2026 use sheet "Average Weekday" with A4 "Exit Station Two-Letter Code". Row totals were recomputed and match the published last column for all 50 stations. Codes: EMBR=EM, MONT=MT, POWL=PL, CIVC=CC, 16TH=16, 24TH=24, GLEN=GP, BALB=BP.
BART 8 SF stations, Jul/Aug mean: 2024 = 66720, 2026 = 85978 (ratio 1.2886); systemwide ratio 1.2806; downtown 4 (EMBR+MONT+POWL+CIVC) ratio 1.314.

BART Central Subway window: Feb/Mar 2023 vs Oct/Nov 2022 SF 8-station ratio 1.0161, systemwide 1.0018; Powell (Union Square/Market St transfer) 1.0018. Seasonal (fall vs late winter) and Thanksgiving effects are mixed in.

Kastle values are transcribed from Kastle's own weekly table images; each table shows two consecutive weeks, so weeks without a captured report were taken from the next report's prior-week column. Holiday weeks are not excluded except where noted (Nov 2022 also given ex-Thanksgiving).
Hotel occupancy series is a 4-week moving average reported weekly by the City; no monthly STR figures were reachable.

Muni ridership (item D): data/beta3/raw/obs/muni_ridership_by_route.csv has every month Jan 2019 - Sep 2026 (93 months), with Weekday/Saturday/Sunday rows. Target months present with weekday route rows: Oct 2022 (54), Nov 2022 (55), Feb 2023 (57), Mar 2023 (57), Jul 2024 (58), Aug 2024 (58), Jul 2026 (58), Aug 2026 (58). Route naming changes across the window: "KT Ingleside/Third" (Oct-Nov 2022) becomes "K Ingleside" + "T Third" (from Jan 2023); "1X California Express" appears from Feb 2023; "L Taraval" rail row in 2026 (L bus in 2024); "30X Marina Express" in 2026.
Existing data/beta3/raw/gtfs/muni-2024.zip (2024-06-22..2024-08-16) already covers the Jul/Aug 2024 backcast network.
